Method of Attack: ransomware attack disrupting operations and accessing audio-visual archive containing sensitive hearing recordings
Impacted Systems: Victoria's court systems including case management systems and administrative solutions
Supreme Court hearings (Court of Appeal, Criminal Division, Practice Court)
County Court hearings (criminal and civil courts)
Attack Vector: cyberattack allowing unauthorized access to audio visual in-court technology network
Indicators of Compromise: unauthorized access to video recordings and audio recordings of court hearings between November 1 and December 21, 2023
exposed recordings going as far back as November 1, 2023
